systems.system: Systeme integre de gestion des finances publiques (SIGFiP)
systems.tiers: From 1 January 2026, under article 82 of the finance law, recruitment and career acts of civil and other agents paid from the payroll, the national police included, are initiated and validated only in SIGFiP; acts taken outside it are void

note: The passages touch the police only through the payroll rule of article 82, a personnel matter; the proces-verbaux named are committee minutes and tax-audit reports. Nothing on station records.
